title: Teacher workload
statementMd:
For each teacher show the number of courses they teach and the total credits. Include teachers with no courses (zero).

Expected columns: `name`, `courses`, `credits`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT t.name, COUNT(c.id) AS courses, COALESCE(SUM(c.credits), 0) AS credits FROM teachers t LEFT JOIN courses c ON c.teacher_id = t.id GROUP BY t.id, t.name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
